inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: A 6 mos old infant was observed sleeping on their stomach.  Caregiver was asked how the infant was placed in their crib and stated on their stomach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: An infant was observed sleeping in a crib with a mattress that was too small for the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: Two out of 10 child files evaluated were missing health statements upon enrollment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: One out of ten child files evaluated were missing updated health statements from the pediatrician after being enrolled for a year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Exception or Exemption on File and Verified: Two out of ten child files were evaluated.  One child had a vaccination affidavit that expired 8/11/25. A second child's vaccination affidavit had partial exemptions noted but did not have a corresponding immunization record showing the vaccinations were received.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Exception or Exemption on File and Verified (26 TAC §746.613(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Training requirements for substitutes, volunteers, and contractors-Orientation: Four volunteer files were evaluated and did not contain a documented orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training requirements for substitutes, volunteers, and contractors-Orientation (26 TAC §746.1403(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Two caregivers did not have a current first aid certificate on file.  One expired 7/2025 and the second expired 8/15/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A storage closet in the restroom of the  main house and an under the sink cabinet in the Sassafras room was unlocked.  Both contained cleaning chemicals accessible to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Two caregivers did not have a current CPR certificate on file.  One expired 7/2025 and the second expired 8/15/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child with a food allergy plan on file did not contain the parent's signature.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: A child with a notarized vaccination affidavit on file did not indicate which vaccines the child was exempt from receiving.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver was observed yelling at a group of children in the Lilac room in an attempt to have the children clean up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A sink cabinet in the Sassafras room  had a broken safety lock allowing access to cleaning chemicals stored inside.  An electric hot water heater in the closet of the Lavender room had a nap cot placed in front of it to prevent access.    NOTE: During the inspection, the safety lock was replaced and a shelf was moved in front of the closet to prevent children from accessing the hot water heater.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The caregiver in the Hawthorne room with a specified age group of 2 year, provided an incorrect headcount of 11 children when asked.  Upon review of the classroom attendance roster with the caregiver, it was determined there were 12 children in her care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Parent's Written Permission for Powders, Lotions, Etc.: Diaper cream that did not belong to a child was applied during diaper changes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Parent's Written Permission for Powders, Lotions, Etc. (26 TAC §746.3501(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Cleanse Child with Individual Cloths: A child was not thoroughly cleaned after having a soiled diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Cleanse Child with Individual Cloths (26 TAC §746.3501(2))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The changing pad in the Sasafras room was a cloth material.    NOTE:  Changing pad was removed during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 out of 10 child files evaluated for immunization records was missing an updated record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The operation failed to maintain the cleanliness of a classroom where dirty toys, excessive clutter, dirt and dead insects were found throughout the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Employees Discipline Own Children: A caregiver physically disciplined their own child who was enrolled at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employees Discipline Own Children (26 TAC §746.2807)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There is a broken window in the Dogwood room that is covered by cardboard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 5 out of 10 child files evaluated were missing addresses and phone numbers for emergency contact people listed on the enrollment form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 2 out of 10 child files evaluated were missing updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: 4 out of 9 infant feeding instructions were not current in the Orange Blossom room.  5 out of 9 feeding instructions were not current in the Peach Blossom room.  Feeding instructions were last updated in January and February.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: 2 out of 3 cats at the operation did not have a copy of their rabies vaccination on file.    Note:  The vaccination records were obtained during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §746.3903(a))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: 1 out of 3 cats at the operation did not have a health statement on file.    Note:  The health statement was obtained from the veterinarian during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §746.3903(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There was 1 loose outlet allowing children to potentially access the electrical outlet box in the wall and there were 2 outlet boxes exposed without covers in the Lavender room.  A sink in the restroom between Hawthorn and Sassafras rooms was pulling away from the wall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: The trash can in the Dogwood room did not have a cover preventing children from accessing the debris inside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: 1 out of 10 child files reviewed was missing a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours: 4 out of 10 staff files evaluated were missing annual training hours.  One caregiver completed 12/24 hours of training, one caregiver completed 18/24 hours of training, one caregiver completed 6/24 hours of training and the director did not have any training certificates available to evaluate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 2 out of 10 child files reviewed needed updated immunization records.  One child (9 mos) was missing their 3rd DTaP and 3rd PCV vaccine.  One child (7 mos) was missing their 2nd Hep B vaccination.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: A child, age 8 years, was observed in the kitchen playing on an electronic device alone without direct supervision.  The child was on the floor of the kitchen behind a metal shelf.  The closest caregiver was in the front office.  There was a curtain that was closed separating the kitchen and office area and preventing a caregiver from being able to see the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: A piece of drywall  has been cut, resulting in  exposing electrical wires that lead from a breaker box located in the Magnolia Room restroom.    NOTE:  This is a recite from investigation #2883999
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The operation used poor judgment in allowing an 8 year old child in the kitchen.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: A caregiver that has a provisional background check had direct access to 4 children ages 6-12 months of age.    NOTE:  The caregiver was moved to another classroom with a caregiver that had an eligible clearance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: This is a recite:   One classroom bathroom contained cleaning solution and wet floor mop pads within reach of the children 2 years of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: This is a recite:    2 children had feeding schedules but were not signed by parents.  1 child's feeding schedule was last updated in Feb 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: This is a recite:    The playground with the tire climber and slides had soft surface measurements  of 1/2 inch - 1 inch at the end of the slides and measurements of 2-5 inches under the climbing unit.    The 3-4 year old playground measured soft surface areas under the rocking climbers between 3- 5 inches in 3 areas measured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File: One infant in the 3-6 mos room was found in their crib in a sleep sack that restricted the child's arms.   A second child was found in their crib swaddled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: A fire extinguisher was found in a 3 year old classroom that was not mounted and placed over 5 feet off the floor on top of a cubby.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §746.5305)

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation: The operation had not recorded monthly carbon monoxide detector testing for January and February.    NOTE:  The assistant director was able to reference past calendar dates and enter the dates the units were tested during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Securely Anchored: Two arch climbers were found on the preschool playground not attached to the ground and could be moved or lifted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Securely Anchored (26 TAC §746.4601(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Two classrooms were found to have cleaning chemicals and sun tan lotion accessible to children in the restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The preschool playground had less than 6 inches of fall zone surfacing under the climbing tires, stationary rocking climbers and arch climbers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: 6 out of 8 infants int he 3-6 mon classroom did not have a feeding schedule on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The operation had not recorded monthly fire drills conducted for January or February.    NOTE:  The assistant director was able to update the emergency log using calendar dates of when the drills were conducted during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))
